fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/Tyres.cy.js#UtilityPages - Tyres [en] — Tyres TC-TYR-01: View September Offer lead submits successfully on Tyres
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TYR-01
**Title:** View September Offer lead submits successfully on Tyres
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Tyres page, click a tyre card's "View September Offer" button to open its lead form, fill name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A successful lead submission redirects the user away from the Tyres hub to that tyre model's detail page (no inline Thank You confirmation here, unlike other CheckOffersLead usages on the site).

**Steps:**
1. Open the Tyres page
2. Click a tyre card's "View September Offer" button to open its lead form
3. Fill name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify the redirect to the tyre detail page
